items.q: How do I book with Conexión Caribe?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp or use “Plan my trip”. We prepare a proposal with confirmed availability and prices, and you book once you're happy with it.

items.q: Are the prices on the website final?
items.a: They're for reference. The final price depends on dates, season, availability and group size, and we always confirm it before you pay.
Mainly Punta Cana, Bávaro, Cap Cana, Bayahíbe and La Romana. We also organize excursions to Samaná, Santo Domingo and other parts of the country.

items.q: Do you organize group and corporate trips?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate incentive trips, celebrations and events with transportation, activities and dinners for groups of any size.
